title: save_diff_bundle RL_FREEs an Odin temp-arena interior pointer (UB) on the T2-mismatch diagnostic path
evidence:
out := make([]rl.Color, n, context.temp_allocator)
		...
		dimg: rl.Image
		dimg.data = raw_data(out)
		dimg.width = expected.width
		dimg.height = expected.height
		dimg.mipmaps = 1
		dimg.format = .UNCOMPRESSED_R8G8B8A8
		rl.ExportImage(dimg, strings.clone_to_cstring(fmt.tprintf("%s/%s/diff.png", dir, base), context.temp_allocator))
		rl.UnloadImage(dimg)

raylib source (tools/raylib-sw/src/src/rtextures.c:612-615):
void UnloadImage(Image image)
{
    RL_FREE(image.data);
}
raylib.h:141: #define RL_FREE(ptr)        free(ptr)
detail: dimg.data points into the Odin temp arena, but raylib's UnloadImage calls free() on it — free of an interior arena pointer is UB (abort/heap corruption). Fires exactly on a T2 pixel mismatch, when the agent-readable diff bundle is the required diagnostic.
recommended_fix: Do not wrap arena memory in an rl.Image. Write the diff PNG via a temp file (rl.ExportImage then delete) or copy `out` into a RL_MALLOC'd buffer, or skip UnloadImage and free the arena via free_all.

title: check_golden leaks the captured frame image on the pixel-mismatch branch
detail: Every branch unloads the captured frame (lines 75, 93) except the mismatch>0 branch: `img` (1280x720x4 ≈ 3.7MB) leaks per failing capture until process exit. Repeated across demos in one `harness run`, the leak accumulates in the headless rlsw process.
recommended_fix: Add rl.UnloadImage(img) after save_diff_bundle in the mismatch>0 branch (or restructure check_golden to unload img once before the branch tail).

title: Replay gate cannot reproduce the `bare` fixture: fixture is not part of the ODN-11 log/manifest contract
detail: The demo language documents `map bare` and run_demo live-runs it via run_context_create_bare, but the blessed log records no fixture and both replay entry points hardwire bare=false (dead `bar` var). A blessed bare demo would false-fail the replay gate against the 6-node bootstrap map — the replay contract is incomplete for the documented fixture.
recommended_fix: Record the fixture in the log header (or manifest) and thread it through replay_hashes; or reject `map bare` at parse with 'replay unsupported' until the contract carries it.

title: Committed 2MB app.bin build artifact (tracked in the PR, not gitignored)
evidence:
git diff --stat main...HEAD -- app.bin:
 app.bin | Bin 0 -> 2057480 bytes
 1 file changed, 0 insertions(+), 0 deletions(-)

git ls-files | grep app.bin: app.bin
.gitignore contains 'bin/' and 'goldens/_reports/' but no root app.bin; commit 0118cc0 message: "fix: pipe hit-testing follows the rendered bezier; router right-click inspects; readable HUD font"
detail: A built, platform-specific 2MB binary is tracked in the reviewed PR with no evidence of deliberation (commit message is about bezier hit-testing). It bloats the repo and will rot against source changes; builds are reproducible via tools/harness.sh, so the artifact adds nothing.
recommended_fix: Remove app.bin from the tree and add `app.bin` (or `/app.bin`) to .gitignore; rebuild binaries locally, never commit them.
